questions.answer:

questions.name: #3 BMI
questions.answer:
The following graph gives information about Aim for a healthy weight. 
The height is between 140 centimeters to 200 centimeters, and the weight is between 30 kilograms to 150 kilograms. 
It is clear that obese occupies the largest percentage, above BMI 30. 
Then overweight normally takes up the area between BMI 30 and BMI 25. 
What's more, the healthy weight ranges between BMI 25 and BMI 18.5. 
Finally it is underweight below BMI 18.5. 
In conclusion, this graph summarizes information about body mass.

questions.name: #4 Neutron Decay
questions.answer:
The following graph gives information about the types of decay in neutrons and protons. 
When it comes to the yellow one, it increases from 6 to 82 protons, with the neutrons ranging from 6 to 126. 
However, the range is also the same but the number is slightly larger. 
Moreover, we can see there are fission, represented by green, proton, represented by red, neutron, presented by purple and stable nuclide, represented by black. 
To sum up, the chart shows us different kinds of decay and the relationship between neutrons and protons.

questions.name: #5 Air Pollution
questions.answer:
The following graph gives information about the chemical transformation. 
The first step is about chemical sources, generated from industry, transportation, ore smelting, and power generation. 
Secondly, it is about emissions, which means wastes will be emitted to the atmosphere such as nitrogen oxides and sulfur dioxide. 
The third step is about chemical transformation. 
After that is divided into two ways, for one it goes to condensation and for the other, it becomes dry fallout including particulates and gases. 
Finally, they will form the precipitation, acid rain, fog, snow, and mist. 
To sum up, this graph tells about chemical transformation.

questions.name: #6 Paper Making
questions.answer:
The following graph gives information about the process of plantation. 
The first step is about radiating pine thinning. 
Secondly, it is about de-barking drum. 
And then the third step is about a chipper which can chip the plantation. 
After that, it's the thermomechanical refiner and it requires water to operate. 
Finally, the paper-making machine completes the whole papermaking process. 
To sum up, the graph tells about how paper is made.

questions.name: #8 Earth Structure
questions.answer:
The following graph gives information about the earth structure. 
According to the picture, from the inside to the outside, there is an inner core, whose radius is 800 miles, or 1300 kilometers. 
Following that, it's the outer core, whose thickness is 1400 miles, or 2250 kilometers. 
And then it's the mantle, with the thickness of 1800 miles, or 2900 kilometers 
The outermost layer is the crust, and its thickness is 5-25 miles, or 8-40 kilometers. 
In conclusion, the earth has a very complex structure.

In conclusion, the picture shows how phases of the moon influence fish's behavior.

questions.name: #32 Maslow's Pyramid
questions.answer:
The following graph gives information about Maslow's pyramid with different levels of needs. 
 Form the top to the bottom; we can see there are 5 kinds of needs, which are self-actualization, esteem needs, belongingness and love needs, safety needs, and physiological needs. 
Specifically, safety needs include security and safety and belongingness and love needs include intimate relationships and friends. 
Apart from that, we can also see from the right-hand side that the needs can be divided into three categories, self0fulfilment needs, psychological needs, and basic needs. 
In conclusion, Maslow’s needs demonstrate that the people’s needs are gradually growing from a lower level to a higher level.

questions.name: #77 Hydro-electric Powerstation
questions.answer:
The following graph gives information about the working principle of water power generation. 
 Firstly, water is sourced from the reservior and gets into the system via an intake. 
After the intake, the water enters a penstock which leads to a turbine. 
The water can power the turbine which can generate electricity with a generator. 
The generator is assembled in a powerhouse. 
The generated electricity can be provided to the users via long distance power lines. 
The water can go back to the river and the process can be continued. 
 In conclusion, this image gives a vivid demonstration of the process of water power generation.

questions.name: #120 Silkworm Life Cycle
questions.answer:
The following graph gives information about the life cycle of the silkworm. 
It starts with eggs laid by adult moths. 
After 10 days, the eggs become silkworm larva, feeding on mulberry leaves. 
After 4-6 weeks, the larva comes into the thread stage, in which silk thread starts to cover the larva. 
After 3-8 weeks, the silk thread becomes a cocoon. 
In 16 days, the cocoon is broken and a moth comes out. 
To sum up, this image tells about the life cycle of the silkworm.

It is clear that the warm regime and cool regime are altered throughout time.

questions.name: #131 Frog Life Cycle 1
questions.answer:
The following graph gives information about the life cycle of a frog. 
It starts with an egg mass produced by an adult frog. 
The eggs become small tadpoles. 
Later, they become tadpoles with legs. 
After that, tadpoles come into the young frogs, which have four legs but with a small, short tail. 
After the tail falls off, they become an adult frog eventually. 
The adult frogs can lay eggs so that the process can start over. 
 In conclusion, this image gives a vivid illustration of the life cycle of a frog.

The pupa becomes an adult fly eventually and the process starts over. 
In conclusion, this image gives a vivid illustration of the life cycle of a fly.

When parasites reach the liver, many consequences occur. 
For example, a human may experience sweating, muscle stiffness, fever, and shaking. 
In conclusion, this flow diagram tells about how parasites can be transferred into human bodies.

questions.name: #152 Milk Production
questions.answer:
The following graph gives information about the process of milk production. 
Firstly, cows are grazed and they can produce milk through milking machines. 
Milk can be obtained twice a day. 
Some of the milk is sent to refrigeration storage, and the rest is delivered to Dairy by a milk tanker daily. 
In the Dairy, the milk is processed in two ways. 
One is to make the it into dairy products, while the other is to pasteurize and package it. 
The packaged milk is sent to the supermarkets and shops for sale. 
To sum up, this graph tells about how milk is processed.

In conclusion, world precipitation is affected by geographic locations.

questions.name: #165 Material Recycling
questions.answer:
The following graph gives information about the recycling process in the industry. 
There are five stages in total and it is a cycle process. It starts with the manufacturing production going to transportation, and after transportation, the utilization is reused. 
While the products are provided to the users, the disposal is recycled and sent to the material extraction stage. 
After the material extraction stage, the materials which can be used are sent to the manufacturing production again to be reused, and the process is continuing. 
 In conclusion, this graph clearly shows the recycling process in the industry.

The graph shows the information about the food web in the temperate forest. 
Firstly, on the top of the web, the cougar and the bear feed on deer. 
Then, the second layer includes the fox and the owl, and their main source of food are rodents and birds. 
In the same level, there are animals like skunk, bird, and opossum, and their main food comes from insects. 
To sum up, the graph tells about the food web in the forest.

questions.name: #215 Food Pyramid 1
questions.answer:
﻿This picture shows the pyramid of food required by the human body. 
At the bottom, we can see water, which is the most essential material. 
Above water, there are whole grain foods such as rice, cakes, and biscuits. 
Then it is a level for fruits and vegetable. 
Grapes, oranges, and apples are in the fruit section, and broccoli, potatoes, and carrots are in the vegetable section. 
What's more, milk products, fish, poultry and eggs appear on a higher level. 
At the top, a level stands for sweets and oil. 
In conclusion, all the levels in the pyramid are important for humans.

questions.answer:

 As we can see, from the bottom, there are wattle and daub. 
 And up to the top, we can see upright loom, large timbers to make mainframe, space for smoking preserving meats and fish. 
And the smoke is released through the thatch, with no need for a chimney. 
Inside the tent, things include a door, some beds, the main hearth, a small domed kiln and some logs for sitting. 
In conclusion, the structure is complex, and the hatch is brown.

questions.name: #223 Solar Eclipse 1
questions.answer:
The following graph gives information about different kinds of solar eclipse. 
When we look at the left-hand side of the picture, we can see the sun. 
In the middle of the picture, there is the moon, which is on the moon's orbit. 
On the right of the picture, it is the Earth, and it orbits around the sun. 
According to the graph, the shade of the moon is called penumbra, creating the partial eclipse. 
Also, people in the middle of a shade called umbra will see a total eclipse. 
To sum up, this graph shows the formation of different eclipses.

questions.name: #236 Arctic Food Chain
questions.answer:
The following graph gives information about the Arctic food chain. 
According to this graph, the first step is that diatoms eat algae. 
And, the second step is that copepods eat diatoms. 
You can see from this graph that the third thing is that arctic cod eat copepods. 
Next, it is that ringed seals eat arctic cods. 
Then, polar bears eat ringed seals. 
Finally, algae absorb excrement. 
In conclusion, the Arctic food chain will repeat.

Finally it is a red fruit that comes out of the flower, and the cycle will start over. 
To sum up, this graph tells about tomato life cycle.

In conclusion, this graph shows the formation of different eclipses.

questions.name: #410 Maslow's Hierarchy
questions.answer:
﻿The pyramid shows Maslow’s pyramid with different levels of needs. 
From the top to the bottom, we can see there are 5 kinds of needs: self-actualization, esteem needs, belongingness and love needs, safety needs, and physiological needs. 
Specifically, safety needs include security and safety and belongingness. 
And love needs include intimate relationships and friends. 
Apart from that, the needs can be divided into three categories: self-fulfillment needs, psychological needs, and basic needs. 
In conclusion, Maslow’s needs demonstrate what the people's needs consist of.

Finally, surface run-offs go to the sea. 
To sum up, this graph tells about water cycle in nature.

Finally, the plastic materials turn into new bottles waiting for refilling. 
To sum up, this graph tells about recycling of plastic bottles.

From the picture we can see the first step is seawater, which is taken from the sea and is to undergo pre-treatment.

To sum up, the graph tells about desalination of seawater.

In conclusion, this picture is about the geocentric theory.
